title: Unified storage, Dactyl seam, migration, and compatibility issue sweep
intent: Implement the user-requested Decapod GitHub Issues #1028, #1110-#1112, #1120, #1216-#1217, #1220-#1224, and #1247 in one reviewable PR, preserving existing interface boundaries and proving each issue-relevant behavior.
proof_hooks: Live issue acceptance mapping covers every requested issue
Focused tests cover storage, migration, Dactyl boundary, and compatibility behavior
cargo fmt --check and targeted cargo tests pass
decapod validate passes with current governance artifacts
stop_conditions: Stop for human review if live issue requirements conflict materially or require expanding beyond the listed issues.
Do not weaken migration, session, workspace, interface, or validation gates to make the issue sweep pass.
Do not claim an issue resolved without a linked implementation and proof result.
deferred_questions: Full all-store call-site migration and live cloud conformance remain contingent on a verified Decapod-compatible Propodus Dactyl HTTP route; report this boundary explicitly if it cannot be proven in this repository PR.

forbidden_paths: External credentials, production data, unrelated repository migrations, and direct mutation of .decapod state.
